home.ecosystemTitle: The Integrated Supply Chain Agriculture Ecosystem
home.ecosystemP1: At Flora Global, we believe that the world’s most demanding markets require more than just a product—they require a proven, transparent journey. Our business is built on a closed-loop ecosystem that manages every critical touchpoint of the agricultural value chain.
home.ecosystemP2: By importing our own Japanese-standard inputs, managing 20 hectares of premium yellow passion fruit across Vietnam’s most fertile provinces, and leading the technical audit for global certifications, we eliminate the risks associated with third-party sourcing. This is not just farming; it is a meticulously managed supply chain designed to deliver the “Honey No. 9” sweet profile with 100% traceability.

pillars.title: ELITE INPUTS
pillars.body: We import fully fermented, heat-treated chicken dung from Japan to ensure soil vitality and high-nitrogen nutrition, laying the groundwork for high-brix fruit.

pillars.title: PRECISION GROWING
pillars.body: Spanning Dong Nai, Long An, and Kien Giang, our farms utilize high-precision biological protocols to ensure consistency, sizing, and the signature 17-19 Brix sweetness.

pillars.title: TOTAL COMPLIANCE
pillars.body: Our in-house certification experts manage the rigorous auditing for USDA, EU Organic, GlobalG.A.P., and HACCP, removing the regulatory barriers to entry.

pillars.title: SEAMLESS EXPORT
pillars.body: Our integrated logistics infrastructure manages everything from post-harvest cooling to international freight and documentation, ensuring arrival at peak freshness.
